articles.title: Illinois agrees to six-month delay of crypto tax as industry continues court battle
articles.snippet: Both sides agreed the 0.2% tax should be put off until July 1, if the court approves the deal, which will let the state and industry focus on the legal dispute.

articles.title: Crypto lost $1.26 billion in hacks while bitcoin bulls enjoyed a monster quarter
Citigroup raises 12-month bitcoin target to $113,000 as ETF inflows resume
articles.snippet: Citi also raised its 12-month target for ether from from $2,240 to $3,028.

articles.title: Blast to wind down Ethereum L2 after costs outpace revenue
articles.snippet: Once among Ethereum’s largest layer-2 networks by total value locked, Blast is urging users to move their assets to mainnet ahead of the shutdown.

articles.title: CONNECT recap: Arthur Hayes on money printing, Wall Street moves onchain
articles.snippet: Arthur Hayes said money printing could lift crypto prices, while CONNECT Seoul speakers examined Wall Street’s competitive edge onchain.
